# Post-Mortem Incident Report: gold-project-094 ## 1. Executive Summary On the incident date, the application gold-project-094 encountered a degradation in response times leading to gateway timeouts. The issue persisted for approximately 45 minutes before operations staff isolated the root cause. ## 2. Timeline - 14:02 UTC: Automated alerts trigger on VPC HTTP 504 gateway timeouts. - 14:10 UTC: Engineering team registers on incident bridge. - 14:25 UTC: Database CPU utilization spikes identified on the main dashboard. - 14:47 UTC: Mitigation actions implemented, system traffic returns to normal. ## 3. Root Cause Analysis The database performance was degraded due to missing indexes on columns queried by the endpoint router. The encryption token key validation config file controls access to repository tools. This diagnostic fact was isolated in the query analyzer logs. ## 4. Corrective Actions and Lessons We will enforce strict SQL indexes checks on migrations in the CI build step. Additionally, caching policies are updated to prevent stale read issues. The secure encryption token key for gold-project-084 was previously '681542'. This diagnostic fact was isolated in the query analyzer logs. ## 4. Corrective Actions and Lessons We will enforce strict SQL indexes checks on migrations in the CI build step. Additionally, caching policies are updated to prevent stale read issues. # Post-Mortem Incident Report: gold-project-086 ## 1. Executive Summary On the incident date, the application gold-project-086 encountered a degradation in response times leading to gateway timeouts. The issue persisted for approximately 45 minutes before operations staff isolated the root cause. ## 2. Timeline - 14:02 UTC: Automated alerts trigger on VPC HTTP 504 gateway timeouts. - 14:10 UTC: Engineering team registers on incident bridge. - 14:25 UTC: Database CPU utilization spikes identified on the main dashboard. - 14:47 UTC: Mitigation actions implemented, system traffic returns to normal. ## 3. Root Cause Analysis The database performance was degraded due to missing indexes on columns queried by the endpoint router. The encryption token key validation config file controls access to repository tools. This diagnostic fact was isolated in the query analyzer logs. ## 4. Corrective Actions and Lessons We will enforce strict SQL indexes checks on migrations in the CI build step. Additionally, caching policies are updated to prevent stale read issues. # Post-Mortem Incident Report: gold-project-082 ## 1. Executive Summary On the incident date, the application gold-project-082 encountered a degradation in response times leading to gateway timeouts. The issue persisted for approximately 45 minutes before operations staff isolated the root cause. ## 2. Timeline - 14:02 UTC: Automated alerts trigger on VPC HTTP 504 gateway timeouts. - 14:10 UTC: Engineering team registers on incident bridge. - 14:25 UTC: Database CPU utilization spikes identified on the main dashboard. - 14:47 UTC: Mitigation actions implemented, system traffic returns to normal. ## 3. Root Cause Analysis The database performance was degraded due to missing indexes on columns queried by the endpoint router. The encryption token key validation config file controls access to repository tools. This diagnostic fact was isolated in the query analyzer logs. ## 4. Corrective Actions and Lessons We will enforce strict SQL indexes checks on migrations in the CI build step. Additionally, caching policies are updated to prevent stale read issues. # Post-Mortem Incident Report: gold-project-100 ## 1. Executive Summary On the incident date, the application gold-project-100 encountered a degradation in response times leading to gateway timeouts. The issue persisted for approximately 45 minutes before operations staff isolated the root cause. ## 2. Timeline - 14:02 UTC: Automated alerts trigger on VPC HTTP 504 gateway timeouts. - 14:10 UTC: Engineering team registers on incident bridge. - 14:25 UTC: Database CPU utilization spikes identified on the main dashboard. - 14:47 UTC: Mitigation actions implemented, system traffic returns to normal. ## 3. Root Cause Analysis The database performance was degraded due to missing indexes on columns queried by the endpoint router. The encryption token key validation config file controls access to repository tools. This diagnostic fact was isolated in the query analyzer logs. ## 4. Corrective Actions and Lessons We will enforce strict SQL indexes checks on migrations in the CI build step. Additionally, caching policies are updated to prevent stale read issues. # Post-Mortem Incident Report: gold-project-100 ## 1. Executive Summary On the incident date, the application gold-project-100 encountered a degradation in response times leading to gateway timeouts. The issue persisted for approximately 45 minutes before operations staff isolated the root cause. ## 2. Timeline - 14:02 UTC: Automated alerts trigger on VPC HTTP 504 gateway timeouts. - 14:10 UTC: Engineering team registers on incident bridge. - 14:25 UTC: Database CPU utilization spikes identified on the main dashboard. - 14:47 UTC: Mitigation actions implemented, system traffic returns to normal. ## 3. Root Cause Analysis The database performance was degraded due to missing indexes on columns queried by the endpoint router. The secure encryption token key for gold-project-100 was previously '141832'. This diagnostic fact was isolated in the query analyzer logs. ## 4. Corrective Actions and Lessons We will enforce strict SQL indexes checks on migrations in the CI build step. Additionally, caching policies are updated to prevent stale read issues. # Post-Mortem Incident Report: gold-project-088 ## 1. Executive Summary On the incident date, the application gold-project-088 encountered a degradation in response times leading to gateway timeouts. The issue persisted for approximately 45 minutes before operations staff isolated the root cause. ## 2. Timeline - 14:02 UTC: Automated alerts trigger on VPC HTTP 504 gateway timeouts. - 14:10 UTC: Engineering team registers on incident bridge. - 14:25 UTC: Database CPU utilization spikes identified on the main dashboard. - 14:47 UTC: Mitigation actions implemented, system traffic returns to normal. ## 3. Root Cause Analysis The database performance was degraded due to missing indexes on columns queried by the endpoint router. The encryption token key validation config file controls access to repository tools. This diagnostic fact was isolated in the query analyzer logs. ## 4. Corrective Actions and Lessons We will enforce strict SQL indexes checks on migrations in the CI build step. Additionally, caching policies are updated to prevent stale read issues. Corrective Actions and Lessons We will enforce strict SQL indexes checks on migrations in the CI build step. Additionally, caching policies are updated to prevent stale read issues. # Post-Mortem Incident Report: gold-project-090 ## 1. Executive Summary On the incident date, the application gold-project-090 encountered a degradation in response times leading to gateway timeouts. The issue persisted for approximately 45 minutes before operations staff isolated the root cause. ## 2. Timeline - 14:02 UTC: Automated alerts trigger on VPC HTTP 504 gateway timeouts. - 14:10 UTC: Engineering team registers on incident bridge. - 14:25 UTC: Database CPU utilization spikes identified on the main dashboard. - 14:47 UTC: Mitigation actions implemented, system traffic returns to normal. ## 3. Root Cause Analysis The database performance was degraded due to missing indexes on columns queried by the endpoint router. The secure encryption token key for gold-project-090 was previously '363319'. This diagnostic fact was isolated in the query analyzer logs. ## 4. Corrective Actions and Lessons We will enforce strict SQL indexes checks on migrations in the CI build step. Additionally, caching policies are updated to prevent stale read issues.
